Author: Vibe Code
Name: JEBlock
Description: When using Triggers or Puppeteer for emotes, your partner can escape by tapping jump, or performing a new /emote. This plugin blocks those actions when /wringhands is detected. You can only escape by moving your character (which may be denied, or locked, by the restriction from Gagspeak)
Punchline: Jump/Emote Block (JEBlock) compliments Gagspeak. Lock your partner into an emote without forcing HARDCORE mode.
